methodology: Crop timing rules are general frost-relative planning guidance synthesized from Cooperative Extension schedules. The local anchor comes from NOAA freeze climatology; the current NWS forecast remains a separate immediate-risk check. Seed packet, cultivar, soil temperature, heat, moisture and local Extension guidance can change the right date.

crops.name: Tomato
crops.note: Wait until freeze risk has passed and nights are reliably mild; protect from cold setbacks.

crops.name: Pepper
crops.note: Peppers are slow indoors and dislike cold soil and cold nights.

crops.name: Eggplant
crops.note: Treat like peppers: warm soil, warm nights, no frost exposure.

crops.name: Broccoli
crops.note: Cool-season crop that can go out well before the warm-season garden.

crops.name: Cabbage
crops.note: Hardened transplants tolerate cool spring conditions.

crops.name: Cauliflower
crops.note: Best growth comes from steady cool conditions without severe cold stress.

crops.name: Kale
crops.note: One of the more cold-tolerant garden crops.

crops.name: Lettuce
crops.note: Direct sow early; heat matters more as spring advances.

crops.name: Spinach
crops.note: Direct sow very early as soon as soil is workable.

crops.name: Peas
crops.note: Direct sow into cool soil; mature before summer heat.

crops.name: Onions
crops.note: Long indoor lead time when grown from seed.

crops.name: Snap Beans
crops.note: Direct sow after frost risk drops and soil warms.

crops.name: Sweet Corn
crops.note: Plant after the soil has warmed; cold wet soil delays emergence.

crops.name: Cucumber
crops.note: Short indoor lead; avoid overgrown root-bound transplants.

crops.name: Squash
crops.note: Warm soil is important; direct sowing often works well.

crops.name: Melons
crops.note: Needs genuinely warm soil and nights; do not rush.

crops.name: Carrots
crops.note: Direct sow; transplanting disturbs the root.

crops.name: Beets
crops.note: Direct sow in cool spring soil.

crops.name: Radishes
crops.note: Fast cool-season crop; succession sow before hot weather.

crops.name: Basil
crops.note: Cold-sensitive herb; wait for warm nights.
